short: No earlier sentence-level AVSR study in the ledger trains hybrid CTC/attention (0 of 32), but no CTC- or attention-only result, LRW under the no-external-data claim, one run: standard.
position: M06 changed, standard: none of the 32 earlier sentence-level AVSR studies in the ledger trains a hybrid CTC/attention objective, but the paper reports no CTC-only or attention-only result, and the concurrent visual-only GRID study found a tuned jointly trained variant worse than a single-loss cascade. The same objective is used in the current best LRS2 system (1.5% WER at 3,448 h), where encoder and data, not the objective, account for the gap (inference). M07 and M12 incidental, standard: an RNN-LM on LibriSpeech text with no LM-free result, and a noise sweep over non-babble noise types with no variability estimate. The visual-only 'without using any external databases' claim rests on an LRW-pretrained front end.
